answers.question: What does my plan look like over the next few months?
answers.text:
Your long-term plan runs from Monday, August 31 through Sunday, November 22. You are currently in week 1, in the Base phase, which started Monday, August 31 and ends Sunday, September 13. The next phase begins Monday, September 14. In total, the plan has 12 weeks and 9 phases.

Here is the phase-by-phase outline:

- Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks). You establish walking as the foundation habit that makes extra movement feel normal.
- Build: Monday, September 14 to Sunday, September 20 (1 week). You build on that base by adding cycling to the mix, keeping movement varied without losing momentum.
- Recovery: Monday, September 21 to Sunday, September 27 (1 week). A recovery block gives your body room to adapt while walking remains a gentle, calm presence.
- Build: Monday, September 28 to Sunday, October 11 (2 weeks). You return to building your walking habit and let stairs become a natural part of your routes.
- Maintain: Monday, October 12 to Sunday, October 18 (1 week). The middle of the plan stabilizes your new pattern, so weight can keep drifting down without strain.
- Recovery: Monday, October 19 to Sunday, October 25 (1 week). A refresh block keeps you moving gently and resets your energy for the next stretch of progress.
- Build: Monday, October 26 to Sunday, November 8 (2 weeks). You return to focused walking habits, using stairs as a simple strengthening tool.
- Maintain: Monday, November 9 to Sunday, November 15 (1 week). Late in the plan, you protect the habit by choosing walking paths and times that fit your normal rhythm.
- Recovery: Monday, November 16 to Sunday, November 22 (1 week). The closing stretch refreshes your motivation and leaves you ready to continue losing weight through movement.

The weekly sessions follow the same rhythm, with easy walks as the key session in most weeks, cycling in the Build phase, and recovery walks in recovery weeks. A detailed written plan is available for the week from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 6, covering 1 week.
